qa_flags.question: Karl Ackerman asked what drove the largest delta versus the prior ~$960M outlook (specific customer ramp vs. broader order-rate strength)
qa_flags.response_pattern: 迴避量化單一驅動因素，CFO 以「一般性評論」帶過，不指名特定客戶

qa_flags.question: Christopher Rolland asked whether FY27 growth should be modeled at the high or low end of "mid-single digits" given the Q2 beat
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未直接回答上緣或下緣，以未完成句子帶過，沒有具體錨定數字

qa_flags.question: Sean O'Loughlin asked whether the 4th hyperscaler is still expected to be a >10% customer for full fiscal '26 as stated last quarter
qa_flags.response_pattern: 與前季說法矛盾／下修：CFO 改口稱該客戶可能不會在全季或全年達到 10%

qa_flags.question: Karl Ackerman asked why Q4 gross margin guidance was cut roughly 360bps at the midpoint
qa_flags.response_pattern: 保留，反覆以「保守預測」帶過，未具體點名產品組合驅動因子

qa_flags.question: Karl Ackerman asked how the ~$5 billion AEC TAM splits between front-end and back-end/scale-out links
qa_flags.response_pattern: 先迴避（自稱不是聚焦由上而下市場預測的公司），才給出概略估計

qa_flags.question: Tom O'Malley and Tore Svanberg asked which of the three optical legs (discrete DSP, ZF Optics, silicon photonics PICs) will be the single largest FY27 revenue contributor
qa_flags.response_pattern: 迴避指名，僅重申三者都在快速成長、其中一項會最大，但拒絕點名是哪一項

qa_flags.question: Vijay Rakesh asked for the precise timing of the 800G-to-1.6T ramp transition
qa_flags.response_pattern: 保留，坦言很難談論確切時機，改用產業層級的籠統說法帶過

qa_flags.question: Blayne Curtis asked about customer-concentration lumpiness risk heading into fiscal '27
qa_flags.response_pattern: 保留，僅泛稱會有一些變動，未提供具體客戶層級數字或情境
